notes: Reconciliation points for the driver. (1) FIXTURE: diesel is Burst II — controlComp() fixes crown at B2 and puts the carry in a B3 slot; a B2 carry either competes with crown at stage 2 or never casts at all depending on first-ready selection. Tests MUST assert diesel actually emits burstCast events in the fixture used (else the burst nuke, Max-HP buff, and Attract lines are all silently dead and every burst assertion is vacuous); if she never casts, build a custom comp with a real B3 instead of blindly using controlComp. (2) SHARED-PRIOR MISREADS I most expect: 'Reload 86.62% of the magazine' encoded as reloadSpeedPct instead of an instantReload-style refill; Pierce Damage ▲30% encoded as generic team damage (it must be inert for non-pierce attackers — assert via 30→0 patch inertness); 56.7% read as the at-cap total instead of per-stack (the literal per-stack reading gives a ~2000-round magazine at 10 stacks — a signature, assertable behavior: reloads nearly vanish at steady state); and the ×5 boss hit on the '5 enemy units' burst. (3) SAWTOOTH: the skill2 pair is a build(700 rounds)-consume-rebuild cycle; the stack REMOVAL at trigger (magazine snapping back toward base) is load-bearing for reload cadence — a model that leaves the +567% magazine permanent over-credits uptime. Whether 'Reload 86.62% of the magazine' resolves against the base (300) or still-buffed magazine at the consume instant is kit-ambiguous — ⚑ flag, don't silently pick. (4) hitCount counts ROUNDS and MG hitsPerShot=1, so 70 'landed attacks' = 70 bullets; MG wind-up shapes early cadence, so first-stack timing assertions should read the event log rather than assume a flat fire rate — the cadence tuple is ALWAYS-⚑. (5) Attract is the gate key for two skill1 lines; today all three Attract-linked lines are unmodeled/GAP, which is coherent — but if any one is modeled, the burst must simultaneously open a name-keyed 'Attract' status window or the gate is dead code.
